title: Oozy Peppery Italian Ground Pistachios Torta Caprese
description: A one-pot Italian dish featuring ground pistachios, with a peppery and cheese-pull texture, made in an air fryer and following ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly principles.
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground pistachios, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, pepper, and salt, and mix well.
Add the chopped basil and tomato sauce to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Transfer the dough to a greased air fryer basket and shape into a torta caprese.
Drizzle the olive oil over the torta caprese and cook in the air fryer for 15 minutes.
Flip the torta caprese over and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the torta caprese from the air fryer and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
